title: Common augmentation representatives for additive etale Cech cohomology
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a finite open covering with all positive tuple intersections affine, I an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], n a nonnegative integer, and s a degree-n cycle of its global section complex. Using the alpha, beta and total complex T of [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization], there exist an ordinary unit Cech cycle z [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] and total cycles t_alpha,t_beta with iCycles(t_alpha)=alpha(iCycles(s)), iCycles(t_beta)=beta(iCycles(z)), and equal total homology classes.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine cover proof; Tags 01EQ and 01FD, augmented double-complex construction and naturality.

proof.text: Use the proved alpha cycle-realization lemma, which uses only restriction naturality and cancellation of the degree-zero Cech differential, to obtain t_alpha with the required inclusion.

Apply beta realization of an arbitrary total homology class to h=homologyPi(t_alpha). Obtain z and t_beta with the required beta inclusion and homologyPi(t_beta)=h. Reverse that equality and combine the three witnesses. No alpha quasi-isomorphism or injective-row acyclicity is used.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 20.11.2 alpha chain map, together with Tag 03P2 affine beta comparison; only beta needs a quasi-isomorphism in this direction.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveCech_common_representative
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ)
    (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n) :
    ∃ (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
      (tα tβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n),
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα =
        additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s) ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ = additiveCechBeta U I n
        ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z) ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tα =
        (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ
